nuggets.text: Eddie Robinson Jr. was twice named SWAC Defensive Player of the Year as an Alabama State player, in 1990 and 1991.
Eddie Robinson Jr. entered the SWAC Hall of Fame at 28, the youngest inductee in league history at the time.
Eddie Robinson Jr. played 11 NFL seasons and helped the Tennessee Titans reach Super Bowl XXXIV.
The Hornets have scored at least 30 points in 15 straight games.

Quarterback Andrew Body is the reigning SWAC Offensive Player of the Year.
Nehemiah Hixon set up two Hornets scores against Southern with punt returns of 33 and 43 yards.
